description: Log in to ouicu, once per computer, before the other ouicu tools appear. It opens ouicu's approval page in the person's browser when it can and waits for them to approve. When it answers with a code and an address instead, show both to the person, ask them to open the address while logged in to ouicu.com and approve the code, then call this again to finish. The key is saved where the ouicu CLI keeps it, so `ouicu` in a terminal is logged in too.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the approval before answering (60).

name: ouicu_login
title: Log in to ouicu
